note: A group needs two members to fold anything. Before this refusal the loader accepted it and the build failed in compile with an unlocated 'at least 2 items' error. Allowed twin: group-member-shapes-load, whose umbrella has exactly two members.
fails_if: the register loader stops validating each [[group]] as the build writes it, so a one-member group loads and the build later fails unlocated (pipeline_build_failed)
